additional_info.subject: RE: ID0426939-DC/Si-D/DE-[P8F40w] Multiple Errors CRM:00797001893
additional_info.body:
Hello RC-DE Team
,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
EFA Tankstellen GmbH
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / P8 170000921 ERK
Charger ID/Serial No.:
P8F40w
Problem Description:
IMD_BC2 - PE connection interrupted
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since
12/16/2024
, as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Upon reviewing the active error flags, we noticed that the charger has an IMD_BC2 active error. This indicates a potential issue with the PE (Protective Earth) connection related to the IMD_BC2.
We recommend checking the tightness of the IMD_BC2 connections, particularly the Earth connection, as well as verifying communication lines. Kindly refer to the diagram below for troubleshooting guidance.
If the issue persists after tightening the cables, we suggest swapping the IMD with a spare unit to determine whether the problem lies with the component itself.
MLFB:
8EM5903-0AA00-0AA1
IMD_BC2
PLC
PROTECTION
true
PE connection interrupted
false
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With best regards,
